semantics.geometry: Per endpoint-class means of eight constructed exposed-development rows at each of ten cue bins, using first3 of7 fitted coordinates; not individual observations or whole-cue display PCA.
semantics.native: Fixed equal-session mean of corresponding7D bin embeddings from pair-supervised session encoders, followed by the same eight-row class mean.
semantics.time: CEBRA-Time uses adjacent-bin positives within constructed training rows.
semantics.loss: Saved unsmoothed own-objective total training loss, one value for updates1 through1000; not development loss or decoder accuracy. Objectives differ between Time and native.
semantics.precision: Selected JSON numeric values copied through Python float round-trip with no explicit rounding; plot conversion to float64 only. No new PCA, alignment, embedding transform or neural-array read.
semantics.claim_limits: Known-label construction; historically exposed contributor-disjoint development. No simultaneous population, natural-trial inference, biological uncertainty or geometry-comparison claim.
